006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import java.time.LocalDate;
011import java.time.LocalTime;
012import java.time.ZoneOffset;
013import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
014import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
015import java.time.temporal.TemporalAccessor;
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.regex.Matcher;
018import java.util.regex.Pattern;
019
020import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractCustomJavaDataTypeAdapter;
021import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousDate;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
023import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateItem;
024import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
025import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
026import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
027import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
028
029/**
030 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
031 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date">date</a>
032 * data type.
033 */
034public class DateAdapter
035    extends AbstractCustomJavaDataTypeAdapter<AmbiguousDate, IDateItem> {
036  @NonNull
037  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
038      List.of(
039          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "date")));
040  /**
041   * Provides a coarse means to parse the date from the timezone. Java handles
042   * parsing the rest and raising any temporal errors.
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  private static final Pattern DATE_TIMEZONE = ObjectUtils.notNull(
046      Pattern.compile("^(-?[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})"
047          + "(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?$"));
048
049  DateAdapter() {
050    super(AmbiguousDate.class, IDateItem.class, IDateItem::cast);
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
055    return NAMES;
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
060    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public AmbiguousDate parse(String value) {
065    Matcher matcher = DATE_TIMEZONE.matcher(value);
066    if (!matcher.matches()) {
067      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date: " + value);
068    }
069
070    String parseValue
071        = String.format("%sT00:00:00%s", matcher.group(1), matcher.group(2) == null ? "" : matcher.group(2));
072    try {
073      TemporalAccessor accessor = DateFormats.DATE_TIME_WITH_TZ.parse(parseValue);
074      return new AmbiguousDate(ObjectUtils.notNull(ZonedDateTime.from(accessor)), true);
075    } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
076      try {
077        TemporalAccessor accessor = DateFormats.DATE_TIME_WITH_OPTIONAL_TZ.parse(parseValue);
078        LocalDate date = LocalDate.from(accessor);
079        return new AmbiguousDate(ObjectUtils.notNull(ZonedDateTime.of(date, LocalTime.MIN, ZoneOffset.UTC)), false);
080      } catch (DateTimeParseException ex2) {
081        IllegalArgumentException newEx = new IllegalArgumentException(ex2.getLocalizedMessage(), ex2);
082        newEx.addSuppressed(ex);
083        throw newEx;
084      }
085    }
086  }
087
088  @Override
089  public String asString(Object obj) {
090    AmbiguousDate value = toValue(obj);
091    return ObjectUtils.notNull(value.hasTimeZone()
092        ? DateFormats.DATE_WITH_TZ.format(value.getValue())
093        : DateFormats.DATE_WITH_OPTIONAL_TZ.format(value.getValue()));
094  }
095
096  @Override
097  public IDateItem newItem(Object value) {
098    AmbiguousDate item = toValue(value);
099    return IDateItem.valueOf(item);
100  }
101}
